headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 30, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a thrilling 8-6 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Griffin Conine leading the offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. Meanwhile, the Arizona Diamondbacks shut out the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-0, with Eduardo Rodriguez pitching 8.0 innings and allowing 0 earned runs. The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Washington Nationals 5-2, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jakob Junis, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Texas Rangers due to a left adductor strain. The Rangers also transferred Jose Corniell from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list and Danny Jansen from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. Other notable injuries include Curtis Mead, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Boston Red Sox due to a left wrist tracture, and Byron Buxton, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Minnesota Twins due to right hip impingement.

The Texas Rangers made a significant trade, acquiring RHP Chase Silseth and C Logan O'Hoppe from the Los Angeles Angels in exchange for SS Angel Arredondo. The Baltimore Orioles also made a trade, sending RF Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, with a final score of 8-6. Griffin Conine led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eduardo Rodriguez leading the way on the mound. Rodriguez pitched 8.0 innings, allowing 0 earned runs and striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Nationals 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs. Trey Yesavage earned the win with 6.2 innings pitched, striking out 4 and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Tigers in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a hard-fought 10-9 win over the Detroit Tigers, coming out on top in a closely contested matchup. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Place Junis on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Jakob Junis, a right-handed pitcher for the Texas Rangers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain, effective retroactive to July 29, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rangers Acquire Chase Silseth in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels traded RHP Chase Silseth and C Logan O'Hoppe to the Texas Rangers in exchange for SS Angel Arredondo. The trade was completed on July 29, 2026.
